description: Session 交互式 Followup 消息注入——让用户在 session 运行期间从 Web 页面向 agent 发送自由文本消息，通过 SignalR 推送到 runner，runner fire-and-forget 调用 connection.prompt() 写入 opencode DB，由 runLoop 在下一个迭代边界捡起

tasks.title: Server followup API endpoint + SignalR push to runner
tasks.description: Add POST /api/projects/{projectRef}/issues/{number}/sessions/{name}/followup endpoint to IssueRoutes.Sessions.cs. Add ResolveFollowupTargetAsync to AgentSessionQuerier returning a FollowupTarget record (RunnerId, WorkflowRunId, SessionName, IsActive) by reusing FindCurrentSessionAsync. Validate request: 400 for empty/whitespace/missing text, 404 for unknown session, 409 when StatusName is not 'active', 503 when RunnerConnectionTracker has no connection for the runnerId. On success, push 'ReceiveFollowup' via IHubContext<RunnerHub> to the runner's connectionId with payload { workflowRunId, sessionName, text } and return 200 { status: 'sent' }.
acceptanceCriteria: POST .../sessions/{name}/followup returns 200 { status: 'sent' } for an active session with an online runner
Returns 400 when text is empty, whitespace-only, or missing
Returns 404 when no session exists for the given name
Returns 409 when AgentSessionJsonHelper.StatusName(session) is not 'active'
Returns 503 when RunnerConnectionTracker.GetConnectionId(runnerId) returns null
ResolveFollowupTargetAsync correctly reads RunnerId from AgentSessionRow.RunnerId and WorkflowRunId from session labels
Followup API spec tests pass following the pattern in AgentSessionRecoveryApiSpecs.cs
Server build succeeds with dotnet build (TreatWarningsAsErrors)
tasks.output: Modified IssueRoutes.Sessions.cs with followup endpoint; new ResolveFollowupTargetAsync + FollowupTarget record on AgentSessionQuerier; passing API spec tests
tasks.notes: Inject IHubContext<RunnerHub> and RunnerConnectionTracker into the session route group or the endpoint handler. Follow the existing compact/reset endpoint pattern in IssueRoutes.Sessions.cs for route registration and error handling.

tasks.title: Runner ReceiveFollowup handler + fire-and-forget prompt + PromptKind tagging
tasks.description: Add a 'ReceiveFollowup' handler to RunnerSignalRClient that accepts { workflowRunId, sessionName, text }. Add an optional FollowupTargetResolver callback parameter to RunnerSignalRClient constructor; wire it from RunnerHost as a closure that reads this.sessionManager + this.sharedAcpConnection at call time. The handler resolves the active ACP session via the callback, emits a prompt-start session event with promptKind 'followup' through the existing ServerConnection event-reporting path, then calls connection.prompt() fire-and-forget with .catch to swallow rejections. If no session matches, silently return.
acceptanceCriteria: ReceiveFollowup handler calls connection.prompt({ sessionId, prompt: [{ type: 'text', text }] }) without awaiting
Handler silently drops the message when FollowupTargetResolver returns null (no active session), does not throw
connection.prompt() rejections are caught and logged; runner process does not crash
Followup turn is tagged with promptKind 'followup' via emitted session event before prompt() call
RunnerHost passes the FollowupTargetResolver callback as a new constructor arg to RunnerSignalRClient
npm run typecheck -w packages/runner passes
npm test -w packages/runner passes (including new handler unit tests)
tasks.output: Modified runner-signalr.ts with ReceiveFollowup handler + callback param; modified host.ts with callback wiring; passing runner tests
tasks.notes: Trace emitSessionEvent calls in acp-agent.ts monitorPrompt to understand the existing prompt-start event pattern for PromptKind tagging (design D6). If event-based tagging proves impractical, fallback: detect the <system-reminder> wrapper client-side in the sessionUpdate stream.

tasks.title: Web SessionFollowupComposer on SessionPage
tasks.description: Create a SessionFollowupComposer component (textarea + send button) and render it at the bottom of SessionPage between the transcript scroll container and JumpToBottomButton. Add a postFollowup(number, name, text, projectId) API client function to entities/coder-session/api/client.ts and a useFollowupMutation hook. Show the composer when isRunning is true; disable/hide when session is in terminal state. Show brief 'sending' -> 'sent' state on success; inline error on 409/503; disable send button when text is empty.
acceptanceCriteria: Composer renders at bottom of SessionPage when session isRunning is true
Composer is disabled or hidden when session is in terminal state (completed/failed)
Typing text and clicking send (or pressing Enter) calls POST .../followup via useMutation
On 200 response, textarea clears and a brief success state is shown
On 409 or 503, an inline error message is shown (no uncaught exception)
Send button is disabled when textarea is empty or whitespace-only
npm run typecheck -w packages/web passes
npm run test:run -w packages/web passes
tasks.output: New SessionFollowupComposer component; new postFollowup API function + useFollowupMutation hook; modified SessionPage.tsx with composer integration; passing web typecheck + tests
tasks.notes: No optimistic transcript insertion — the followup message surfaces via SSE when opencode processes it. Follow the existing compactSession/resetSession API client pattern for postFollowup.
